The Grizzlies defeated the Pelicans, 142-111 tonight in New Orleans. Jerami Grant finished with a team-high 22 points along with 3 three pointers for the Grizzlies, while Ty Jerome tallied 17 points, 9 assists and 2 rebounds in the game. Saddiq Bey recorded 30 points, 10 rebounds and 6 three pointers. The Grizzlies improve their record to 8-4 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 4-9 for the season.
